definition: Kavita Annapoorani Ganesan is a Malaysian-born author, data scientist and AI consultant known for her research in the fields of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and natural language processing.
details: She wrote the book, The Business Case for AI and founded the company Opinosis Analytics. Her works have been cited over 1500 times according to Google Scholar.

explainer.lead: Kavita Ganesan is a Malaysian-born author and data scientist.

contributions.name: While working at GitHub, Ganesan founded the Utah-based AI and machine learning company Opinosis Analytics.

timeline.what: In 2021, Ganesan was nominated for the Rising Star Award at VentureBeat's Women in AI Awards.
In 2022, Ganesan published the book The Business Case for AI: A Leader’s Guide to AI Strategies, Best Practices & Real-World Applications.
